purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: Natural young-person transition language can contain studies, rent and a changing first income at the same time, while the visible product previously split study-to-work and housing support into separate shallow routes. That risks missing the 2026 annual-income/change-reporting next action or repeating facts already known from the situation.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Detect only bounded young/study plus housing-benefit or housing+income-change language, pass a coarse young_housing focus and income_change context without raw story or exact age, ask only route-changing age/housing questions, and keep eligibility/amount in the verified review chain.
